An undead skull kept aloft by unholy clouds of collective misery, which slowly drift out in its wake. It mourns without end for the living, the dead, and its own former life all alike.

A gaunt spirit of frozen hunger, so ravenous it will consume friend and foe alike. According to legend, if one cuts off its legs, it will feast upon its own marrow. It stalks those lost wandering in the cold and hunts with the force of blizzards.
A muscular white-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.
A small and mischievous minor demon covered in frost.
An ancient warrior, kept in a state of perpetual undeath by its desire to die with honour in battle.
A green-glowing gaseous entity, flickering and pulsing irregularly as it hovers through the air. Travelers have been known to confuse these for distant lanterns - a mistake rarely made twice.
A small but powerful dragon, particularly adept amongst its kin at manipulating the currents of air that surround it. It can exhale powerful blasts of wind.
A strong wild canine, with sharp teeth and a healthy appetite.
A hairy fast-moving hunting spider with vicious mandibles, the size of a wolf. It roams the dungeon in search of prey, which it kills with its deadly venom.

A cloud of thick fog, with faint, feeble claws constantly reaching out and then fading back into the fog. When threatened, it calls forth creatures banished to the void between realities, using them to defend itself.
A cloud of black mist surrounding an insubstantial skeletal form. Its eyes burn bright with unholy malevolence and hunger for life essence, on which it feeds.
A conflux of unearthly light and energy, awash in unnatural colours and strange forms no normal being was meant to perceive. It fills all those in its presence with the disorder of the Abyss.

A small and strangely serpentine fold in space and time. Scholars once theorised the Dungeon's easy access to manifold unholy realms is due to the tunneling of yet-undiscovered translocations dragons. Whether or not this is true, distant stars mottle this drake's endless lengths, and dimensions bend to its writhing whim.
A dragon-like creature with a long, sharply pointed tail. Although smaller and less formidable than true dragons, it is nonetheless a foe to be reckoned with.
A common dungeon yak, covered in shaggy yak hair and bearing a nasty pair of yak horns.
A hybrid with the torso of a robust human atop the body of a yak. It excels in ranged combat, and is also a formidable foe in close quarters.
An exceptionally strong and brutish yaktaur, able to order its weaker brethren around to do its bidding.
A muscular yellow-scaled humanoid with a reptilian tail and small wings.
A winged demon covered in shiny metallic scales. It has a legion of minor demons at its command, which it impels to savage fury.
A corpse raised to undeath by necromancy.
A demon born of mortal envy, its flesh undulating with a sickening wetness whenever it moves. It is driven by a singular desire to reduce all beauty to a form as hideous as its own.

(If you see this outside wizmode or the arena, this is a bug.) Whatever it is, it is capable of spawning countless monsters by casting Shadow Creatures, and is virtually undestructible itself. To destroy it, lower the central elevator pillar, then pump rockets into the hole in its exposed brain when the pillar rises to an appropriate height. You can add another rocket while jumping down. Oh wait, wrong game.
The remains of a monster that existed in an older version, but has since been removed.
A hostile monster whose presence has been detected.
A trivially weak monster whose presence has been revealed by the power of Ashenzari.
A weak monster whose presence has been revealed by the power of Ashenzari.
A somewhat dangerous monster whose presence has been revealed by the power of Ashenzari.
A very dangerous monster whose presence has been revealed by the power of Ashenzari.
A friendly monster whose presence has been {{ if you.god() == "Ashenzari" then return "revealed by the power of Ashenzari" else return "detected" end }}.
A strange wizard who has attained mastery over clouds, making deft and foreboding mystic gestures.
A powerful warrior-mage who instructs aspiring students in physical, magical, and anti-magical combat.
A mighty spellcaster wreathed in arcane energies, muttering profane incantations.
A mighty old lich, notorious for blasting people with powerful conjurations at the slightest provocation, or just on a whim.
A statue made of a fine glassy orange crystal. It depicts a mystic known as Wucad Mu, who mastered the matters of the mind, and is imbued with Wucad Mu's powers of mental combat.
A bizarre breed of intelligent troll, glowing with mysterious power from beyond this world which shields it from damage except at close range.
A delicate statue of a tengu gliding through the air. It looks quite insubstantial.
An unfathomably expensive skeleton. It has countless sigils engraved into its bones, and pulses with a ghostly presence.
A statue of a beautiful elven archer, sculpted in finest marble. It holds a bow aloft, and appears to be magically animated, letting it use the bow to riddle intruders with arrows.
An undead figure preserved by the brackish waters of a bog. It has begun to decay heavily, and looks fragile.
A wild-eyed wizard whose tongue has been cut out, frantically mumbling and waving its arms but unable to cast a single spell.
A statue that has been imbued with flame, allowing it to make use of simple fire-based conjurations.
A terrifying creation that appears to have been constructed from the body parts of every monstrous creature imaginable, with writhing tentacles sprouting from its form.
A statue able to harness the mightiest of pure conjurations ever devised by Iskenderun.
A poor creature that looks hideously deformed.
A demonic mockery of a plant, covered with mysterious appendages and writhing tentacles. It appears to be harmless.
A terrible creature with demonic ancestry. Its presence is horrifying, but supernaturally compelling.
A dwarf who seems to be working as an ale quality tester, and is enjoying the job a little too much.
A plain statue of a dwarf wielding a pickaxe. It looks incredibly heavy.
An ornately worked statue of an orc holding a torch aloft, hewn from black basalt. The air around it shimmers.
An animated mound of misshapen flesh, sculpted over an iron skeleton.
A statue of a mage, with frost constantly forming across its surface.
A goblin newly converted to Nemelex Xobeh. It's still learning about all the cards and, thankfully, isn't inclined to use them against you.
A mighty spirit drawn from the elemental plane of air, surrounded by a deadly vortex of frost.
An undead creature in the shape of a bat, made of ice.
A kobold that has been enchanted to explode in a blaze of fire.
A young merfolk that looks deeply ill, but is still capable of bespelling its audience.
A demented wizard commanding the primal forces of the universe.
A bat that, despite its name, is not any smaller than a megabat.
A follower of Okawaru, granted the honour of spectating a duel to the death.
A mere plant that has somehow attained sentience and the use of magic, by some inconceivable sorcery.
An immature oklob plant that seems to be mumbling some orisons... er, what?!?
A metal golem crackling with magical energies. It must have been created by a truly devious wizard, or possibly someone who misheard what monsters could be found in the Realm of Zot.
A strange, glowing bat that flutters through more dimensions than the average bat.
An otherworldly spider that can move short and medium distances by briefly shifting between the planes of reality, in order to better ensnare its prey.
An immaculately sculpted porphyry statue of an archer poised to release a bolt, with a full quiver at the hip.
A bat that is well past its sell-by date.
A young merfolk that looks quite sick, but still has the power to mesmerise its victims.
A bat skeleton without the decency to lie unmoving like dead bats are supposed to.
A spriggan that has mastered the culinary arts.
A smooth statue of a beautiful merfolk bathing in a fountain, sculpted from creamy, faintly pinkish travertine. It glistens softly in the light.
An old and unnaturally ugly human, wearing robes stained with what appears to be swamp ooze, cauldron soot and brew ingredients.

A plant whose life has been drained away, but with its physical form still intact. It looks like it died many {{ if you.branch() == "Crypt" or you.branch() == "Tomb" or you.branch() == "Zot" then return "centuries"; else return "years"; end }} ago.
A giant annelid, glistening with slime, with unusually large teeth.
A divine agent of Zin. It is a towering winged figure with an aura of brilliant white light. Its face is marked by a scowl, as if its zeal against any real or perceived vice overshadows its goodness.

A profoundly disturbing statue, hewn from a single piece of dark gabbro scintillating with tiny crystals. It is impossible to tell whether it is intended to represent some creature or personage, or to be completely abstract.

One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. It is a horrendous imitation of the human form, consisting of an unrecognisable mass of meat stitched together with limbs sewn on seemingly at random. Its skin hangs off loosely in some places and bulges repulsively in others. Each one bears a large symbol carved into its flesh, a mark of pride from its twisted creator.

One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. Its bloated hulk pulsates and throbs constantly with accursed fires. It looks as if it could explode into a torrent of viscera at any moment.

One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. Its form is large and muscular. It moves swiftly and with impetuous fury, the sole thought within its being to rend you apart with great fervour. As it rages, it creates a cacophonous din.

One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. Each of its eight necks is distended and elongated, connected to a colossal body crumpled and dripping with ichor. Its many heads spew blood while writhing and convulsing in agony, as it brings torment to itself and anything else that beholds its foul visage.

One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. Ablaze with demonic frenzy, it gores and tramples with ferocity unmatched. Its skin is flayed, exposing the glistening tendons and sinew underneath, and the teeth inside its cavernous maw are stained with blood.

An artisan of unlife, the sculptor appears as a grim skeletal form. It has six long arms ending in mangled hands with broken fingers, upon which it crawls like a spider. Its skull is abnormally large and full of holes. Its bones are reddened and fractured, inscribed with the unholy spells it weaves to assemble its puppets.
The destroyers begin to descend upon you. They come in numbers and with wrath, maws gaping like abaddon, bottomless and abyssal. They bring your doom and will feast on your remains.
The accursed are the ones who came before. They have come to ensure you share their fate.
A colossal mass of bones and skulls, a walking tomb. You hear shrieks and screams as it approaches, shattering off bones with each crushing step, reassembling itself in eternal unrest.

An affront to existence, a void in which there is only torment and damnation. Its unearthly form is torn and twisted, black and hollow. It is bereft of rational thought, knowing only hatred and the desire to desecrate your soul.
A vast serpentine form with raw and diseased skin, seeping bile and pus, spouting venom and blight.

You see the unseen, you stare and they stare back. They whisper and laugh, they grin and cry, they leer at you with contempt and gaze at you in adoration. They are the observers, they are the judge of your worth and will decide your end.
A spectre, struggling to leave the mortal world it is incarcerated in. It drains life and unlife from all those it comes into contact with.
One of the greatest servants of the Meatlord. It is muscular, agile and full of malevolence.
An emaciated figure brimming with damnation and plague. Its appearance signifies the end of days.
His glaive is alight with the flames of hell.
His shield is emblazoned with images of infernal flames.

You behold the embodiment of filth, corruption and depravity: the Meatlord. His foul body is bloated to the extreme, leaking viscous fluid and the stench of death. His head is that of a boar with bulging eyes and tusks split in two, his snout flares and oozes as he snorts and squeals at the sight of you, and his mouth is a toothless rift which drools pools of blood and vomits forth disgusting remains. His neck is stretched and lops forward, its skin sagging downward. His immense gut writhes and distorts as the larvae within await their repugnant release. His legs are unrecognisable masses of flesh, covered in protrusions and throbbing boils. Your mind reels at the sight of this hideous form, and your senses begin to shut down in an attempt to preserve your sanity as you choke on the oppressive stench.
You hear the echoes of planets behind the deafening roar of stars as it approaches. It is the jaws of the abyss. It brings forth crawling chaos from within. It is the last sight you will ever see.
Your epidermis has hardened, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +1 AC.
You are covered in fur, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +1 AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to cold.

You are surrounded by a repulsion field, providing a small amount of evasion. Each level of this mutation provides more EV. The third level of this mutation also repels missiles, greatly increasing your EV against such attacks.
You are covered in blue scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to cold.
You are covered in molten scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to fire.
You are covered in green scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to poison.

You are covered in yellow scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to acid and corrosion.
You are covered in metallic scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides more AC. The third level of this mutation also provides resistance to electricity.
You are covered in brown scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +1 AC and also increases your health slightly.
You are covered in sharp scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +1 AC and Slay +1, improving your accuracy and damage with melee and ranged attacks.
You are covered in iridescent scales, providing a small amount of protection. Each level of this mutation provides +2 AC.
You are covered in bone plates, providing a small amount of shielding. Each level of this mutation provides more SH.
Your bones are light and porous. Each level of this mutation provides +2 Dexterity and Stealth+.

Your muscles have grown unnaturally strong. Each level of this mutation provides +4 Strength, but the extra muscles slow your movements and thoughts, giving -1 to both your Intelligence and Dexterity for each level.

Your mind has become unnaturally acute. Each level of this mutation provides +4 Intelligence, but all the blood flowing to your head weakens your constitution, giving -1 to both your Strength and Dexterity for each level.

Your reflexes have become unnaturally fast. Each level of this mutation provides +4 Dexterity, but the rest of your body can't keep up with your speed, giving -1 to both your Strength and Intelligence for each level.
Your muscles have grown unnaturally weak. Each level of this mutation provides -3 Strength.
Your mind has become unnaturally dopey. Each level of this mutation provides -3 Intelligence.
Your reflexes have become unnaturally clumsy. Each level of this mutation provides -3 Dexterity.
You have an increased reservoir of magic. Each level of this mutation provides +10% MP.
You have a low magical capacity. Each level of this mutation provides -10% MP.

You have both an innate understanding and a greater control over the exact flow of your magic, letting you cast spells with greater efficiency. Each level of this mutation reduces the cost of your spells by 1 MP, to a minimum of 1 MP.

Whenever you use spells or divine abilities with any costs, a shield forms from the excess loose magical or spiritual energy to guard you. The magical energy from spells only sustains the shield for but a moment, while the spiritual energy from using divine abilities lasts a brief bit longer.
Your skin changes colour to match your surroundings. Each level of this mutation provides Stealth+.
Foes who strike you in melee will be frozen, taking damage. This effect is guaranteed to trigger if your foe does any damage.

Your blood has desynchronised itself from the flow of time. Whenever you fall below 66% of your maximum HP, the spilling of your blood surges strangely through your surroundings, hasting two of your strongest allies in sight for each level of this mutation. After doing so, your blood will be unable to further dilate time until your HP has fully recovered.
Your altered digestive system extracts additional value out of select potion types, doubling the duration of all status effects gained via potions.

Your limbs are overflowing with morphogenic power, guiding your every movement. Each other non-innate mutation you have also provides +1 EV and Slay +1 (up to a limit of 7), improving your accuracy and damage with melee and ranged attacks. This still applies even when the mutations would be suppressed by a different form. You currently gain {{ num = math.min(you.how_mutated(true, false, false, true, false) - 1, 7) return "+" .. num .. " EV and Slay +" .. num .. " from this mutation." }}

A vile yet invigorating energy permeates your soul, which resonates with specific other energies released at the moment of death. Whenever poisoned or drained enemies die in sight of you, you have a chance to siphon away a small portion of their life force and magical power. Each level of this mutation increases the chance this happens and the amount one siphons.

You have an uncanny knack for uncovering hidden properties of items other people might ignore as mundane. Whenever you encounter a new item on the ground for the first time, there is a very tiny chance to discover that it is actually an artefact. Each level of this mutation increases that chance.
Your recklessness halves your SH, but the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons is increased by 15%.

A subtle flock of eager sparks and bright cinders chases after your movements. Whenever you deal fire damage to a foe without rFire∞ or electric damage to a foe without rElec∞, you have a chance to outline it with a soft glow of light, which makes it easier to hit and reveals it if invisible. Each level of this mutation increases the chance this happens.

You have horns on your head, allowing you to try to gore foes when launching melee attacks, but preventing you from wearing helmets. Each level of this mutation increases the damage of your gore attacks. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing any type of headgear.
You have a beak for a mouth, allowing you to peck at foes when launching melee attacks, but preventing you from wearing helmets.
You have sharp teeth, allowing you to bite foes when launching melee attacks. Each level of this mutation makes your teeth sharper, longer, and stronger.
You have acidic saliva, allowing you to bite foes and apply corrosion to them when launching melee attacks.
You have a thirst for magic, allowing you to bite foes when launching melee attacks. This restores your magical reserves and also disrupts magical foes, sometimes leaving them unable to act.

You have sharp nails, increasing the strength of your main-hand unarmed attacks if you aren't wearing gloves. If your off-hand is free, the strength of your off-hand punch attacks is also increased. Each level of this mutation makes your nails sharper, longer, and stronger. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing gloves.

Your hands glow with unholy energy, allowing you to inflict irresistible damage when launching melee attacks as long as your off-hand is free. Your touch attacks deal damage which ignores armour, and each level of this mutation increases the damage dealt. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing gloves, and also causes your touch attacks to reduce your foes' willpower.

You have hooves, allowing you to kick foes when launching melee attacks if you aren't wearing boots. Each level of this mutation makes your hooves harder and stronger. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing boots.

You have sharp toenails, allowing you to kick foes when launching melee attacks if you aren't wearing boots. Each level of this mutation makes your nails sharper, longer, and stronger. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing boots.

You have antennae, allowing you to sense nearby monsters, but preventing you from wearing helmets. Each level of this mutation lets you sense monsters from further away. The third level of this mutation prevents you from wearing any type of headgear, and allows you to see invisible monsters.
You have a spiked tentacle, allowing you to pierce foes when launching melee attacks. Each level of this mutation makes your spike sharper, longer, and stronger.

You have a long, snake-like tail in place of feet. This gives you stability in water, but causes you to move much more slowly than most species. The second level of this mutation allows you to constrict foes with your tail when attacking in melee. Your tail can constrict only one enemy at a time, and every attack at this mutation level will begin or renew a constriction attempt. The chances of succeeding are determined primarily by Dexterity, Fighting skill, and any slaying bonuses.
You have a venomous barb on the end of your tail, allowing you to sting foes when launching melee attacks. Each level of this mutation makes your stinger sharper, longer, and stronger.

You have a thin, orange tail, allowing you to attack foes when launching melee attacks. Each level of this mutation increases your tail's strength as it turns into a sharp stinger. The third level of this mutation prevents wearing cloaks or scarves, and causes the stinger to inflict brief weakness on those struck.
You have a large scaly tail, allowing you to tail-slap foes when launching melee attacks.

You are covered in pseudopods, allowing you to slap your foes when launching melee attacks, but somewhat reducing the amount of protection provided by body armour. This has no effect on protection provided by armour enchantments. Each level of this mutation makes your pseudopods larger and stronger.
You are immune to the damage from steam breath and steam clouds.
Your genetic code is unusually stable, making it less likely that you will be mutated (or have existing mutations removed). Each level of this mutation makes you more resistant.
You are less affected by unholy torment, which would otherwise cut your health in half. The second level of this mutation renders you entirely immune.
You resist poisons, toxins and other contaminants. This does not confer full immunity, but reduces your chances of being affected to roughly one-third what it would be otherwise.
You resist heat. Each level of this mutation reduces the amount of damage taken from fire.
You resist cold. Each level of this mutation reduces the amount of damage taken from cold.
You resist electricity (rElec), taking less damage from it.
You resist acid (rCorr), taking less damage from it. You are also less likely to become corroded.
You resist negative energy. Each level of this mutation reduces the amount of damage taken from negative energy, along with the amount that it drains your health.
You are vulnerable to fire and take more damage from it.
You are vulnerable to cold and take more damage from it.
You are vulnerable to both cold and fire, and you take more damage from those effects.
You are vulnerable to electricity and take more damage from it.
You have an unnaturally strong will, improving your resistance to certain types of hostile magic. Each level of this mutation increases your willpower further.
You have an unnaturally weak will, reducing your resistance to certain types of hostile magic. Each level of this mutation reduces your willpower further.
You have supernaturally acute vision, allowing you to see monsters that are hidden from mundane sight. This has no effect on your accuracy otherwise.
Your mind is exceptionally clear, preventing you from becoming confused, mesmerised, or supernaturally afraid. You also cannot become involuntarily enraged.
You have a second sense for the dungeon, allowing you to sense terrain you haven't yet seen. Each level of this mutation allows you to sense more and more thoroughly.
Your wands draw upon your magical reserves, becoming somewhat more powerful in the process. If you have no magic left to draw upon, your wands function as normal.
You heal quickly. Each level of this mutation increases the rate at which you heal.
You do not heal over time while foes are in sight. Other sources of healing, such as potions, are unaffected.

You cover ground quickly - moving to new positions takes you less time. This has no effect on other types of actions, like attacking or casting spells. Each level of this mutation makes you move faster.

You cover ground slowly - moving to new positions takes you more time. This has no effect on other types of actions, like attacking or casting spells. Each level of this mutation makes you move slower.
You can take a beating. Each level of this mutation improves your health further (+10% HP).
Your health is poor. Each level of this mutation worsens your health further (-10% HP).
As you gain experience, your body's hidden potential will express itself in the form of new beneficial mutations.
As you gain experience, your body's hidden potential will express itself in the form of new detrimental mutations.
Your spells are slightly harder to cast (increased miscast chance and severity), but more powerful. Each level of this mutation increases both effects further.
Your spells are slightly easier to cast (reduced miscast chance and severity), but less powerful. Each level of this mutation increases both effects further.

You periodically teleport towards hostile monsters. You will sense yourself destabilising several turns in advance of this happening, and may suppress it temporarily by reading a scroll of teleportation. Each level of this mutation increases the frequency with which you start to teleport.
Your body is shaped in an inhuman way, somewhat reducing the amount of protection provided by body armour. This has no effect on protection provided by armour enchantments.

You are sometimes seized by an uncontrollable urge to scream whenever you sustain an injury. All of your shouts are also louder than usual. The second level of this mutation makes this urge harder to resist and makes your shouts even louder.

Your body reacts poorly to injury; when you suffer damage, you have a chance for your attacks to become weakened for a short while. The second level of this mutation sometimes additionally causes this to slow you as well.

Your system is resistant to potable panaceas, reducing the effectiveness of all kinds of healing potions. The second level of this mutation completely blocks potion-based healing. (Aid from the god Gozag is unaffected.)
Your health recovers twice as slowly from being drained. (The total experience needed is doubled.)
You absorb twice as much mutagenic energy from being contaminated.

The first time you see a monster, it may be magically pulled toward you. This has a chance of waking sleeping monsters, though they will not necessarily be alerted to your position. The second level of this mutation increases the chance of this happening.
When reading scrolls in sight of hostile monsters, your voice resounds with a truly stupendous volume.
Your body is covered in a fungus that metabolises beneficial potions you drink and sometimes emits spores which transmit their effects to nearby monsters - whether friend or foe.

Your blood pulses with a strange predatory malice. When you become significantly injured, some of it may rise up to attack you - though this may not happen again until you heal fully. The second level of this mutation causes two erythrospites to be created at once.

Whenever you translocate, there is a chance that another monster is pulled along to your new location. If you translocated a short distance, this will always be some monster in sight of your previous location, but long distance teleports may pull a monster from anywhere else on the floor. The experience is mildly disorienting for the monster, and it will not be able to act immediately after being pulled this way.
All of your attacks are less effective, dealing less damage and being a little less accurate. This effect worsens with each level of this mutation.

When you are harmed, there is a chance that a demonic guardian will rush to aid you. The greater the damage done and the closer you are to death, the greater the odds. Each level of this mutation increases the strength of your guardians.
When you are harmed, you sometimes gain power, refilling your magical reservoir or granting you temporary agility or might. Each level of this mutation increases the magnitude of this effect.

Foes who strike you in melee sometimes cause you to emit a cloud of foul miasma, slowing and severely poisoning those caught within. This mutation also grants you immunity to miasma (from any source).

Foes who strike you in melee have a 50% chance of being impaled on your spines, taking damage. Each level of this mutation increases the damage. This mutation also grants you immunity to constriction.
While in good health, you are more powerful, casting spells and slaying foes more effectively. Each level of this mutation increases this effect further.
When you are harmed, some damage is redirected to deplete your magic reserves instead.
When low on magic, you restore magic in place of health.

When you cast spells, there's a chance that adjacent monsters will be paralysed. This effect is more powerful when casting higher-level spells, but monsters with greater willpower can resist it. Each level of this mutation allows more distant monsters to be affected. The third level of this mutation also allows you to paralyse monsters in the same way while zapping wands.
You are coated in a protective layer of ice. Fiery attacks can temporarily melt the ice, removing the protection until the ice reforms. Each level of this mutation increases the protection imparted.
A shield of frost guards you, blocking some incoming attacks. Fiery attacks can temporarily melt the shield.
Death fuels you, allowing you to heal somewhat for each life you take. Each level of this mutation increases the healing further.
Your movements are less encumbered by armour, mitigating penalties to spell success, evasion, and ranged weapon attack speed. Each level of this mutation reduces armour ER by 2.
When seriously injured, your blood congeals around you, forming armour. Each level of this mutation increases the AC provided.
What's up? You have a big brain. Each level of this mutation provides +2 Intelligence. The third level of this mutation also makes you less likely to miscast spells.

Whenever you see blood spilled (yours or others'), it may ignite, bursting into a cloud of flame. Each level of this mutation makes this more likely. This mutation also grants you immunity to clouds of flame.

When you injure a foe, your presence may intensify the damage, corroding their weapons and defences. The second level of this mutation makes matters even worse, adding a chance that your wretched victims may become mutated and deformed.
When you strike a foe in melee, the black mark on your body may debilitate them. This can weaken foes, drain their health, or disrupt their magic.
You are surrounded by an aura of silence. Those adjacent to you cannot make any sound. This prevents most forms of spellcasting and prayer, though demonic magic, being noiseless, is unaffected.
You cast Hex spells with increased power.
Your willpower has a will of its own, sometimes injuring those who attempt to hex you. This mutation also bolsters your willpower.
You can hurl damnation with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>. Foes beware!
You can speak a Word of Chaos with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>.
You can spit poison with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>. The second level of this mutation intensifies the poison from a single glob into a large cloud.
Your Necromancy spells are more powerful. The second level of this mutation enhances your Necromancy spellpower further.
Your magical nature helps you tumble your hollow bones around acrobatically, allowing you to evade attacks while moving or waiting.
You fly evasively through the air, increasing your evasion somewhat.
You have big, strong wings, capable of bearing you through the air.
You hover through the air, forever free from the surly bonds of earth.

You cannot learn spells from books. Instead, as you gain experience, spells of higher and higher level bubble up from your fiery heart. These spells are unpredictable and unaffected by your choice of god. You cannot train specific spell schools - you can either train all spell schools at once, or none.

You have no separate reserve of magical power, and anything that would affect MP has no effect on you. When casting spells, using abilities, or doing anything else that *costs* MP for normal species, you spend HP instead.
You are built differently from most species, making you slightly harder to kill. Each level of this mutation increases your maximum health by 4 points.

Your uniquely muscular legs allow you to hop short distances in the blink of an eye with <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input>, though your walking speed is below average. The second level of this mutation allows you to hop farther.
You cannot, will not, and will never worship any god.
You are attuned to the shadows, reducing the distance that you can see or be seen from.

You are made of living stone which is very resistant to damage. You gain a large bonus to your AC, which increases with your experience level, and are immune to petrification, poison, disease, sleep, and certain other effects.
When struck by a cold attack, you may be slowed until your blood warms again.
When launching attacks on unaware or incapacitated enemies, you inflict extra damage in the same way as a human with a short blade might.

You have two pairs of two arms, allowing you to wield two-handed weapons with one pair and a shield with the other, as well as wear a second pair of gloves. You can even wield extremely large weapons like giant clubs, though this takes both arm-pairs.
When a foe misses you in melee, you may reflexively retaliate, attempting to gore your attacker with your horns. You can perform this against a given enemy no more than once per player action.

Every third experience level, you gain an extra life. If you are slain while you still have a life remaining, you will reappear elsewhere on the current floor. You can continue to gain extra lives even once you reach the maximum experience level, but you can't have more than two extra lives at a time.

Whenever you gain experience, it is split between all of your skills. You cannot choose to focus. Effects that prevent you from training certain skills, such as divine restrictions, do not cause your other skills to rise faster.

You can blend into the waves while swimming through water or flying above it, gaining Stealth+. The second level of this mutation also grants you improved evasion and increases your movement speed when in or above water.

Your divine heritage dramatically boosts your attribute gain (Strength, Intelligence, and Dexterity) as you level up relative to other species, both in quantity and in how much you can control your development. Every three levels, you choose an attribute to increase by four points.

Your gelatinous body has eight tentacles that help you move around in shallow or deep water and can be used to constrict enemies while attacking them in melee. Each tentacle can wear a ring, but you need four of them to move around, and either two or four tentacles to hold a weapon depending on its size, and two tentacles to hold a shield. Your tentacles will try to constrict foes which you attack in melee. (You cannot constrict monsters larger than you.) Independently, you have a two-thirds chance of launching a damaging 'squeeze' attack whenever you attack in melee.

Your morphogenic matrix is unstable, allowing your lower body to shift to a powerful aquatic tail when in shallow or deep water. It will quickly reform into legs once you leave the water. When in merform, your tail allows you to tail-slap foes when launching melee attacks.
The darkness flees at your approach, allowing an extended range of vision and ranged attack (+1 line of sight), but also allowing you to be seen and potentially targeted from further away.

You do not regenerate health while resting, and are unable to receive the effects of magic that hastens the speed of regeneration. Sources of HP gain such as potions and religious invocations will still heal you, and certain divine invocations can temporarily grant you the ability to regenerate. To compensate, you are able to heal yourself via the <input>$cmd[CMD_USE_ABILITY]</input> key, at the cost of permanent MP.
You have an uncanny knack for knowing where items can be found. As you explore the dungeon, nearby item locations that you cannot directly see will gain a marker for as-yet-undiscovered items.
Your body is rubbery, and your foes like glue. Each level of this mutation confers +1 AC and +1 EV.

Golden eyeballs sprout from your flesh like mushrooms, confusing your foes. Each level of this mutation improves your accuracy with weapons, unarmed attacks, auxiliary attacks, and spells. The third level of this mutation also allows you to see invisible foes.
Your skin is transparent, improving your stealth and reducing the accuracy of your foes' attacks against you. Each level of this mutation reduces your foes' accuracy further.
When struck in melee, the slimy shroud covering your body may deflect the attack. Such deflection will break the shroud, however, and it will take time for it to reconstitute itself.
When struck in melee, the slimy tendrils covering your body may grab your attacker's weapon and yank it from their grasp, disarming them.
You have a small jelly attached to you that senses nearby items.
When struck by a missile (such as an arrow or crossbow bolt), a jelly on your body may eat it, healing you somewhat.
Your melee attacks may flood the airways of your foes with ooze. Those that need to breathe air will be silenced and take asphyxiation damage over time.
You are foreign to this world, easily perceived by dark forces. You have only one-tenth the normal time on each dungeon floor before Zot finds you and permanently reduces your health.

Your body is shadowed by foul flame. Foes hit you less often, and your stealth is greatly enhanced. Foes who strike you in melee are sometimes seared by the foul flame; undead and demonic foes take less damage from it, while holy beings and good god worshippers take more.
You are invigorated by the discovery of the unknown. As you explore the dungeon, your wounds will heal and your magic will replenish.

You were embalmed with holy oils and sacred spices and bound about with blessed cloth. Now you have a special connection with the divine, allowing you to gain favour with your chosen god more quickly.
When you kill living creatures you have a chance to devour their life force and restore health.

You instinctively roll as you move toward enemies, rampaging forward an additional space. This mutation grants magic regeneration when rolling; the second level of this mutation regenerates both magic and health.
Whenever a potion restores your health or magic, it restores twice as much.
Whenever you drink a potion, you perform an immediate attack against all enemies within melee range.

You can use scrolls of brand weapon, enchant weapon, and enchant armour upon random artefacts. This cannot raise their enchantment above what would normally be possible on a mundane item of the same type, and cannot affect especially unusual artefacts at all.

You cast spells with the assistance of glyphs marked upon your armour, greatly reducing the complex movements which would otherwise be required. (The encumbrance rating of all armour you wear is reduced by 1/2 for purposes of spell success.)

You can wield a one-handed weapon in your off-hand, if not wielding a two-handed weapon or wearing a shield or orb. You will follow up attacks from your primary weapon with your off-hand weapon, with attack delay determined by the average of the two. Ranged weapons can only follow attacks by ranged weapons, and likewise melee weapons.
You must recalibrate your grasping arms when wielding or unwielding weapons. This takes as long as donning armour.

Your grasping arms need time to limber up, making your first few attacks in each fight less effective. Slow, heavy attacks help more than fast attacks. Both weapon-based and unarmed attacks are affected.
Your hands are embedded into the controls for your grasping arms, leaving you with no place to wear magical rings without disastrous magical interference.
Your scales are fused with a thick layer of iron, giving them resilience akin to a suit of armour (+5 AC).

Your magic is resistant to distruption by outside forces. Hostile effects which drain your MP drain only 1/3 as much and you are immune to having your magical effects be removed by anyone but yourself.

You have no physical body and instead interact with the world through haunting objects. This allows you to 'equip' up to 6 boots, gloves, cloaks, or helmets in any combination, but body armour is too large for you to usefully manipulate in this fashion. At higher levels, you can even send the armour you are haunting out to attack enemies independently for short periods of time.

Your connection to the realm of the living grows stronger as you spread misfortune. Whenever you or your allies inflict new negative status effects upon nearby enemies (other than poison), your AC temporarily increases. This bonus improves with the number of different enemies affected, but will decay over time if you do not continue to inflict new misfortune. At your current XL, you can gain a maximum bonus of {{return 6 + you.xl() * 4 / 5;}} AC this way.

You devour the memories and even the very existence of those you kill, subsuming them in the unholy fire that wreathes your body. Once you have accumulated enough memories, you may choose to burn them all away as fuel to greatly enhance your damage-dealing spells for a short period of time. At your current experience level, you can hold enough memories to cast a maximum of {{return 3 + math.floor(you.xl() * 3 / 20);}} spells in a row this way. Upon first gaining this ability, you will recall a fragment of your undead origins, granting knowledge of a damage-dealing spell that can be enhanced in this way.

You instinctually channel destructive magic through your claws. When casting a damage-dealing spell, you also perform a melee attack against the most healthy enemy in your attack range. This attack does reduced damage if your attack speed is slower than your casting speed.
Your accursed nature makes it harder to dispel malignant energies from your being, reducing the rate at which you can recover from Doom and Banes.

You rampage swiftly towards enemies and can continue to trample forward once you reach them, pushing entire lines of enemies backwards as you attack. Performing any action besides a rampage movement will end your stampede. The second level of this mutation augments your stampede with the blessing of one of the four winds, based on your highest skill: North Wind: Melee weapon skills (except Short Blades)
 South Wind: Short Blades or Stealth
 East Wind: Magic skills (except Spellcasting)
 West Wind: Ranged Weapons skill
You rapidly regenerate up to 70% of all damage you suffer while Stampeding. The rate of this regeneration increases with your maximum HP.

Whenever you rampage towards foes while wielding a ranged weapon, you also fire a penetrating shot that does increased damage and your next normal attack becomes empowered to fire at multiple foes at once.

Whenever you Rampage, you regain a small percentage of your maxmimum MP and unleash a bitter wind that makes all enemies within 2 spaces of you Exposed, increasing the damage they take from non-attack sources by 35% and also their chance to be hit or affected by them. Additionally, casting spells will not cause you to stop Stampeding.
Your stealth is increased by 50% while Rampaging and whenever you successfully stab an enemy, your next Rampage movement becomes instant.
Your body lacks a metabolism that can be affected by poison or disease. You do not need to breathe, protecting you from mushroom spores and drowning attacks. You also cannot be put to sleep.
You do not need to breathe air, protecting you from mushroom spores and drowning attacks. You cannot be blinded or put to sleep.

You are fully undead, granting you immunity to poison, miasma, fear, sleep, negative energy, torment, drowning, and the effects of spore attacks. Your form cannot be further changed by magical means, protecting you from polymorph, but also preventing you from wearing talismans. If an effect would mutate you, your health will be temporarily drained instead. You are vulnerable to weapons of holy wrath and certain magics, and cannot go berserk.

When you perform a stab attack against a living monster with blood, you heal for a portion of the total damage dealt. When you are at 50% of your max HP or less, this has a 2/3 chance to happen on all melee attacks.

When you kill a living monster with a stab attack, they may rise again to serve you as a vampiric thrall. Thralls possess all the abilities they had in life, but are undead, and gain a vampiric bite attack as well as increased melee damage against sleeping foes. Spellcaster thralls will also gain knowledge of the Vampiric Draining spell. You can only create a thrall if you do not have one already, and they will inevitably turn to dust after a short time.
You are insubstantial and immune to many effects that require a solid body. You cannot be constricted, petrified, skewered by barbs, covered in sticky flame, or caught by webs, nets, or bolas.

Your breath radiates an intense chill which freezes nearby walls solid as you fight. Whenever you attack, you turn a random wall adjacent to your target or yourself frigid. Frigid walls deal damage to any enemies adjacent to them each turn - up to twice as much when an enemy is adjacent to as many as possible. This damage increases with your shapeshifting skill. The walls will rapidly melt again if you stop attacking.
Whenever an injury reduces your health to less than 50%, angry bees will swarm out of your body to defend you. This effect cannot happen again until your health is fully recovered.

Your body is formed of elemental water that changes shape flexibly, allowing you to reach and perform melee attacks from several tiles away - including auxiliary attacks of all sorts. The precision required to preform stab attacks is still impossible unless you're adjacent to your target, and axes can only cleave to enemies adjacent to you, regardless of where you strike.
When injured, parts of your watery body may splatter as puddles of shallow water nearby. The more damage you take at once, the more water is spread around.
Whenever you are exposed to cold damage, you have a chance to become Frozen, lowering your movement speed for a short while.
Whenever you take fire damage from a projectile, you have a chance (increasing with the damage suffered) to spread steam clouds around yourself.
Whenever you strike an enemy in melee, the wind twists around and strikes them for additional damage which is increased for each empty space adjacent to them.
Your Hexes spells are much easier to cast (reduced miscast chance and severity) and enemies have reduced willpower against all your effects.
You compulsively pose riddles to enemies when you encounter them. Every now and again, these may confuse or vex them, but mostly they just attract their attention.

Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you gain a temporary slaying bonus that increases with your Shapeshifting skill. This bonus stacks up to +12 and will not expire so long as you continue to perform melee attacks.
When you kill an enemy in melee, if your werefury bonus is at least 5, you may unleash a terrifying howl that attempts to freeze all nearby enemies in place with fear if it overcomes their willpower.

Your hair is made of long prehensile jellyfish-like tendrils. Whenever you attack in melee, they will lash out and attempt to poison several visible enemies within 2 tiles of the player at random. The number of enemies they can afflict at once is improved by Shapeshifting skill.

When your health drops to 60% of your max HP or less, your tendrils reflexively attempt to petrify all poisoned enemies within 3 tiles of you. This effect cannot activate again until you fully heal and its success chance improves with your Shapeshifting skill.

When you strike an enemy in melee, a portion of the transmutational energy surging through will contaminate them. Upon landing the third strike in a row, this contamination will grow so acute that it will twist their bodily form, inflicting significant AC-ignoring damage and malmutating them.
Your maw sometimes bites enemies in melee, at a rate independant of your own attack speed (once per 15 aut, on average). Its base damage is directly increased by 75% of your strength.

When you kill an edible enemy in melee (any hostile, non-summoned, living or plant monster), your maw devours it, greatly increasing your regeneration for a short while. More powerful enemies provide a longer duration of this effect.
Your maw's appetite is insatiable. Whenever you first encounter an edible monster, there is a chance to become mesmerised by it and let out a loud growl.
Your melee hits have a 50% chance of discharging an arc of electricity that travels between several connected enemies.

When your health drops to 40% of your max HP, your eels violently discharge electricity, striking all connected targets within 2 tiles of yourself - be they friend or foe - for twice the damage their electricity normally does. This effect cannot activate again until you fully heal.
You briefly gain SH equal to your slaying whenever you perform a melee attack (with an additional flat bonus based on your Shapeshifting skill).

Your melee attacks cause multiple burstshrooms to begin growing on unoccupied tiles behind your target. If they are allowed to grow for several turns, they will explode in a burst of spores that damages nearby enemies and can briefly daze them.

Your body armour is fused into your shell, multiplying its base AC by a factor that increases with your Shapeshifting skill. The effectiveness of its ego and most artefact properties will also be doubled, though certain rare artefacts may be too unusual to enhance this way.

Your gaze has a hypnotic effect on many creatures. Whenever a living, demonic, or holy monster first notices you, it may become momentarily dazed, preventing it from shouting. Creatures which fail a Willpower check will be dazed for even longer.

Whenever you cast spells while in sight of enemies (or witness monsters cast spells themselves), the leftover magical energy will condense into a short-lived cloud of glimmer. Touching that cloud will convert it into a small projectile which unerringly strikes a nearby enemy. Other creatures walking into those clouds will merely push them out of the way.

Four elemental crystals float alongside you - one corresponding to each of Earth, Fire, Air, and Ice magic. Casting a spell of one of those schools will cause a matching crystal with enemies in range of it to surge with power, damaging up to 3 enemies within 3 tiles and charging it. When all crystals become fully charged, you will temporarily gain resistance to elemental damage and regenerate a small amount of health over time.

When gravely wounded, you automatically shed your tail as a defensive response and step away to an adjacent tile. The shed tail will pulse with scintillating colours that distract all nearby monsters and force them to attack it instead of you. Your tail will eventually regrow as you explore more of the dungeon.

As you explore, you will gradually condense the dungeon air into potions of mist, which allow you to become intangible. You can carry no more than five of these at a time and they will be destroyed if you ever permanently leave this form.

Whenever you drink a potion, vapours from it are transmuted within your mane. If you perform a melee attack shortly thereafter, you will spray hazardous clouds in a wide line in the direction of your attack, whose quantity and duration are increased by your Shapeshifting skill. The type of cloud created depends on the potion drank: Mist and Curing: Blinding Haze
 Berserk: Flame
 Mutation: Mutagenic Fog
 All Others: Noxious Fumes
Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Gehenna. You are able to hurl bolts of magma instead of cold, and your bolts of fire can strip away their victims' fire resistance.
Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Cocytus. You are able to hurl bolts of ice instead of fire, and your bolts of cold freeze victims solid, slowing their movement.

Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Tartarus. You are able to hurl bolts of devastation which lower their victims' willpower instead of lightning, and your bolts of negative energy are more powerful.
Your Unleash Destruction ability is empowered by Dis. You are able to hurl bolts of corrosive acid and metal splinters instead of negative energy.

Your Infernal Servants have a longer duration, and you can summon even stronger ones at very high Invocations (at the cost of additional piety). When you slay enemies, a random servant may gain one of: Haste, Might, Regeneration, or Brilliance.

Your Infernal Servants are now summoned adjacent to a random enemy instead of near you. When they appear, they do so in a blast of your characteristic Destruction (which cannot hurt you or other allies). (Your servants unleash blasts of either {{ if you.get_base_mutation_level("Dis destruction") == 1 then return "acid or metal splinters" elseif you.get_base_mutation_level("Tartarus destruction") == 1 then return "negative energy or devastation" elseif you.get_base_mutation_level("Gehenna destruction") == 1 then return "fire or lava" elseif you.get_base_mutation_level("Cocytus destruction") == 1 then return "cold or ice" end }}.)

Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Infernal Legion, allowing you to call in a small army of demons over time. While individually short-lived, their numbers are inexhaustible for as long as the status lasts, and they will never be hostile to you. You may also unleash Makhleb's Destruction through your summoned allies without harming them.

Your Infernal Servant ability is replaced with Globe of Annihilation, allowing you to hurl slow-moving spheres of intense destructive force that detonate in an enormous blast of your characteristic Destruction. (Your globes of annihilation unleash either {{ if you.get_base_mutation_level("Dis destruction") == 1 then return "acid or metal splinters" elseif you.get_base_mutation_level("Tartarus destruction") == 1 then return "negative energy or devastation" elseif you.get_base_mutation_level("Gehenna destruction") == 1 then return "fire or lava" elseif you.get_base_mutation_level("Cocytus destruction") == 1 then return "cold or ice" end }}.)

When you kill enemies, they have a small chance to explode in a violent rain of gore, which damages adjacent foes proportional to the victim's maximum health. Enemies who die to this explosion will always explode themselves.

Whenever you fall below 1/3rd of your maximum HP, you perform an infernal rite, unleashing a flurry of blood arrows aimed at nearby enemies. You will fire at least one arrow for every valid target, but may fire additional ones if few are present. Invocations increases the damage of these arrows, and Makhleb will always bestow healing upon you for enemies killed by them. After performing a blood rite, you cannot perform another until your HP has fully recovered.

A demonic incarnation of murder lies dormant within your soul. Whenever you kill an enemy in melee, there is a small chance for it to awaken and manifest as a maelstrom of scythe-like blades enveloping you. These blades will attack whenever you do and also retaliate whenever you successfully dodge an enemy attack. You have the ability to rampage swiftly towards enemies while possessed, but if you spend more than a short while doing anything other than attacking, the demonic presence will go dormant inside you once again.

Your Unleash Destruction is empowered the more times you use it consecutively without pause, increasing in both damage and health cost. Upon using it a fourth time in a row, you will automatically unleash a wild barrage of additional bolts aimed at random targets and reset this boost.

Grants you the Vessel of Slaughter ability, allowing you to transform into a powerful demonic avatar with greatly boosted offence and defence for a short period of time, in exchange for being dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh afterward and made to fight for your freedom.

You refuse to drink potions in combat unless badly injured. While enemies are in your line of sight (and for several turns afterward), you will be unable to drink anything unless your HP is below 50% of its maximum.

You refuse to read scrolls in combat unless badly injured. While enemies are in your line of sight (and for several turns afterward), you will be unable to read anything unless your HP is below 50% of its maximum.
You are considerably less handy than you used to be. You cannot wield two-handed weapons, wear a shield, launch off-handed attacks, or use more than one magical ring at a time.
You have no Stealth. You will always alert monsters when they see you, and they will track you very effectively.
You cannot voluntarily change forms, via talismans, potions, or any other means. You may still be involuntarily transformed by effects such as wands of polymorph.

You cannot use magical devices. This includes wands and most items evoked with <input>$cmd[CMD_EVOKE]</input>, excepting reaching weapons, talismans, and ziggurat figurines. This also renders magical staves much less effective in melee.

You are hated by all and cannot acquire allies, temporarily or permanently, by any means. Simplistic, unthinking magical constructs, such as spectral weapons, orbs of destruction, and battlespheres, are unaffected.

Seeing threatening monsters fills you with dread, reducing the power of your spells and your ability to slay monsters with melee and ranged attacks. Seeing multiple such monsters at once, or extremely threatening monsters, renders this even worse.
Your chance to miscast spells is higher. Each level of this sacrifice increases the chance to miscast further.
It takes you more experience to improve your skills. Each level of this sacrifice makes your skills cost even more.
You are easily battered and bruised, reducing the benefits of your armour.
Your reflexes are slow, making it easier for foes to hit you.
You are inexperienced and unable to fully gain 27 levels.
You are missing an eye, reducing the accuracy of your physical and magical attacks.
You are incapable of wielding weapons or throwing items.
Your Dodging skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Armour skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Air Magic skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Conjurations skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Earth Magic skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Fire Magic skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Hexes skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Ice Magic skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Necromancy skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Alchemy skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Summoning skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Translocations skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
Your Forgecraft skill is 0 and you cannot train the skill.
You cover ground slowly - moving to new positions takes you 30% more time than normal. This has no effect on other types of actions, like attacking or casting spells.
When you are damaged by fire, you have a high chance to become slowed for a moderate length of time. This chance is decreased by your current level of fire resistance.
When you are damaged by cold, you have a high chance to become weak and blind for a moderate length of time. This chance is decreased by your current level of cold resistance.
When you are damaged by electricity, you have a chance to become bound in place and unable to move for a short length of time. This chance is decreased by your current level of electrical resistance.

You suffer a penalty to the damage and accuracy of your attacks and the power of your spells based on the number of solid feature you are currently adjacent to. (-2 slaying and -10% spell power per solid feature.)
Your evasion is decreased by 25 on any turn where you move or are moved.
Whenever you kill an enemy, all other nearby enemies are healed for a large fraction of that enemy's maximum health.

Enemies in sight of you have a small chance each turn to create multiple clones of themselves. These clones are very fragile and do reduced damage with attacks and spells, but will not expire on their own.

Your skill with your highest weapon skill (at the time of becoming afflicted by this bane) is reduced by 50% and your skill with your two highest skills among magical schools, Invocations, and Evocations are reduced by 25%.

Whenever you first spot a monster, it has a chance to become Touched by Paradox, giving it the ability to use Manifold Assault as a natural ability (and a small chance to blink randomly after doing so).

Groups of enemies you encounter may have Warding, preventing all damage they would take from any source which is not currently adjacent to them (including clouds, if their creator is currently non-adjacent).

Whenever an enemy summons monsters against you, they will usually appear adjacent to you instead of their summoner. Their duration is also increased and they will never lose track of your position, no matter where you flee.

When you are badly injured and alone, a reaper may come to claim you. These reapers will be immune to all damage from non-adjacent sources and, if your XL is less than 14, will additionally be slow. At higher XL, multiple reapers may appear at once. When this bane is lifted, all reapers summoned this way will immediately vanish.
You have a chance of going berserk when you make a melee attack.
You have a chance of being corroded when you take damage.
You have a chance of being slowed when you take damage.
Any damage you deal or take is increased.
You have a chance of causing visible monsters to go into a frenzy when you kill a foe.
You repel missiles, improving your chance to evade them.
You reflect any successfully blocked ranged attacks back towards the attacker.
Your evasion is increased while moving and waiting.
You are protected from involuntary confusion, rage, fear and mesmerisation.
You are partially protected from mutation.
Any damage you take is divided between your reserves of health and magic.
You take an additional free step when moving towards enemies.
You gain divine favour quickly, and greater notice is taken of any religious transgressions you make.
You have a chance of regaining the magic spent when successfully casting a spell, and always regain the magic spent when you miscast a spell.
You spend magic each time you make a melee attack, empowering your blows.
Fighting skill increases your accuracy and damage in physical combat, and also increases your maximum health.

Short Blades are more effective than any other weapon type at stabbing helpless foes. Being skilled with Short Blades will allow you to attack more quickly with all weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them. Being skilled with Short Blades increases your effectiveness with Long Blades, and vice versa.

Being skilled with Long Blades will allow you to attack more quickly with all weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them. Being skilled with Long Blades increases your effectiveness with Short Blades, and vice versa.

Axes cleave through multiple enemies with a single swing, hitting foes in an arc around the wielder. Being skilled with Axes will allow you to attack more quickly with all weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them. Being skilled with Axes increases your effectiveness with Maces & Flails and Polearms, and vice versa.

Being skilled with Maces & Flails will allow you to attack more quickly with all weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them. Being skilled with Maces & Flails increases your effectiveness with Axes and Staves, and vice versa.

Polearms can be evoked with ‘v’ to attack enemies from two spaces away. Being skilled with Polearms will allow you to attack more quickly with all weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them. Being skilled with Polearms increases your effectiveness with Axes and Staves, and vice versa.

Staves require a relatively low amount of skill to be used most effectively, although they lack the high damage potential of some other weapon classes. Being skilled with Staves will allow you to attack more quickly with all weapons of this type, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them. Being skilled with Staves increases your effectiveness with Maces & Flails and Polearms, and vice versa.
Being skilled with Ranged Weapons will let you attack more quickly with all bows, crossbows and slings, as well as increasing your accuracy and damage with them.
Training Throwing will make thrown weapons (such as javelins) more accurate and damaging. It also makes certain magical darts more likely to have an effect.

Armour skill multiplies the AC gained from wearing armour of all kinds, both from body armour and cloaks, gloves, etc. It also slightly lessens penalties to spellcasting and ranged weapon speed from heavy armour.

The Dodging skill will affect your chance of dodging an attack, be it melee, ranged or magical. Certain types of attack cannot be dodged, however, such as enchantments (which must be resisted with willpower) and explosions.

By training Stealth, you can make it less likely that monsters will notice you if they are asleep or otherwise unalert, and increase your chances of monsters losing track of you after you leave their vision. Note that more powerful monsters tend to be more suspicious and observant. Stealth skill, along with the weapon skill for your equipped weapon, also governs the likelihood of doing a great amount of damage when attacking a distracted or helpless creature, as well as the amount of extra damage dealt.

A high Shields skill helps you block melee attacks or non-penetrating projectiles (both magical and non-magical) with your equipped shield, and reduces their penalty to your evasion, attack speed and spellcasting success.
Being skilled in Unarmed Combat increases your accuracy, damage and attack speed in melee combat when barehanded.

{{ if you.race() == "Djinni" then return "Being skilled in Spellcasting increases the success rate and spell ".. "power of all spells." else return "Being skilled in Spellcasting slightly increases the success " .. "rate and spell power of all spells, along with increasing your " .. "magical reserves. Training Spellcasting also gives you more spell " .. "slots to spend on new spells." end }}

Conjurations are battle oriented spells, which often work by conjuring up a chunk of short-lived matter and propelling it towards the victim to deal direct damage. Being skilled in Conjurations usually increases the damage and accuracy of such spells, and sometimes affects their range or the size of the area affected. Being skilled in Conjurations increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Hexes try to bestow various enchantments on nearby things. While none do direct damage, being ensorcelled can effectively take an opponent out of combat, although they often require overcoming an opponent's willpower to have an effect. Skill in Hexes can help overcome this. Being skilled in Hexes increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Summonings deals with summoning creatures from another plane of reality to temporarily aid you. Increasing Summonings skill may grant a number of effects depending on the spell, such as longer duration or more powerful allies. Note that summoned beings do not leave corpses and give no experience when killed, and their equipment is as ephemeral as they are. Being skilled in Summonings increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Forgecraft is the art of shaping tangible objects out of magic. Forgecraft spells can construct a wide array of mechanical creatures that will fight alongside the caster, as well as create traps and barricades and even turn the physical resilience of one's armour into a weapon. Being skilled in Forgecraft increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Necromancy is the art of draining and gaining life, although most often associated with zombies and other undead. As such, Necromancy spells have a wide range of effects, ranging from spells to create or disrupt the undead to spells granting unholy healing in various forms. Being skilled in Necromancy increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Translocations focus on the spatial movement of beings or objects, including useful spells to translocate yourself over short distances quickly or to transport your enemies away from you. Being skilled in Translocations increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Alchemy is the art of toxins and transmutation. Spells in this school can twist objects and creatures into different shapes, unleash powerful poisons, or even unweave the fabric of magic itself. Being skilled in Alchemy increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Fire Magic focuses mainly on dealing fire damage over long distances, with many effective Conjurations. Being skilled in Fire Magic increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Ice Magic contains a range of direct damage spells, as well as some defensive effects - for example, crafting temporary ice armour. Being skilled in Ice Magic increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Air Magic provides spells to deal damage directly with the wind, as well as noisy but powerful lightning Conjurations. It also provides some utility spells, such as a call to the wind to assist your movement or a Hex to prevent most use of magic in the area surrounding you. Being skilled in Air Magic increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Earth Magic contains spells able to deal large amounts of direct physical damage, which cannot be resisted like fire, cold and lightning damage can. It is also linked with Alchemy, with spells to liquefy the earth around you, or to turn your enemies to stone. Being skilled in Earth Magic increases the success rate and spell power of spells in this school. Many spells belong to a combination of several schools, in which case spellcasting success and power will depend on the average skill in these schools.

Your Invocations skill affects the likelihood that an attempt to use divine abilities with certain gods will be successful, and often the power of such abilities. {{ if you.race() ~= "Djinni" then return "The Invocations skill also affects your magical reserves, " .. "but to a lesser degree than the Spellcasting skill. Only the " .. "higher contribution is used." end }}
Evocations skill affects your ability to use magical items like wands and other uncommon objects, increasing the power or success rate of such items.

Shapeshifting enables the use of magical talismans to change oneself into other forms. Sufficient skill allows one to use more powerful forms without gravely damaging one's health. Being skilled in Shapeshifting also makes most forms somewhat stronger, in ways which vary between forms.
Barachim are slow-moving, amphibious humanoids who can hop long distances. Their extended range of vision also allows them to be seen from further away.
Coglins ride enchanted exoskeletons able to wield weapons in both hands, wrapping slow-revving metal around their puny goblinoid frames.
Deep Elves have a strong affinity for all kinds of magic, but are very fragile. They regenerate magical power rapidly.
Demigods refuse to worship any god, but make up for this with divine attributes and high reserves of health and magic.
Demonspawn are half human, half demon. They acquire strong demonic mutations as they grow.
Djinn are ever-burning spirits. They learn spells automatically as they grow, and cast by drawing down their own fires.
Draconians are versatile hybrids. They mature when reaching level 7 and develop a colour.
Formicids are humanoid ants adept at digging. Their limbs are exceptionally strong and they live in a state of permanent stasis.
Felids are many-lived sentient cats. They cannot use armour or weapons.
Powerful equine hybrids who trace their ancestry to the four winds themselves, Gale Centaurs are at their strongest while galloping swiftly towards foes.
Made of living stone, Gargoyles have a preternatural affinity for earth magic. They have low health, but their stone bodies are incredibly tough.
Gnolls are canine-like humanoids. They are unable to specialise in any single skill, but instead gradually become proficient in all skills at once.
Humans are natural explorers. Discovering new places refreshes and invigorates them. They are otherwise completely average.
Tengu are bird-people who love to fight, both with weapons and spells. They are fragile but agile, and eventually learn to fly.
Kobolds are attuned to the shadows and can only see or be seen at a close range. They are small and a little fragile, and are talented in most skills.
Half fish, half human, Merfolk are citizens of both water and land. They are strong combatants, and adept at using magic to assist in battle.
Minotaurs are large muscular humans with bovine heads. They excel at all forms of close and ranged combat.
Mountain Dwarves are strong melee fighters and capable heavy-armoured casters. They can use scrolls to enchant even some artefacts.
Compelled to walk by an ancient curse, Mummies have innate faith and are adept at Necromancy, but learn other skills very slowly. They cannot drink potions.
Nagas are hybrids: human from the waist up, with a snake-like tail instead of legs. They move very slowly but are naturally resilient.
Octopodes are a species of amphibious cephalopods. They can wear eight rings, but almost no armour fits them.
Large, robust, and extremely fond of drinking, Oni make capable brawlers and spellcasters and gain extra benefits from potions.
Formless ghosts who delight in hexing their enemies. They can equip many different hats, gloves, boots, or cloaks at once, but cannot wear body armour.
Revenants are skeletal undead who are strong at melee combat and can empower damage-dealing spells by consuming memories they harvest from their victims.
Very small, very frail and very fast, Spriggans are highly competent stabbers and spellcasters.
Trolls are monstrous creatures with powerful claws. They regenerate health rapidly.
Frail symbionts, Vine Stalkers cannot regain health from potions. Their magical reserves absorb damage, and they pack a magic-restoring bite.
Reduces the remaining duration of any nearby hostile summoned creatures.
Hurls an explosive ball of corrosive acid.
Cuts the health of an adjacent creature in half. This damage is never directly lethal.
Cuts the health of a target creature in half. This damage is never directly lethal.
Causes the air around a creature to twist itself into a whirling vortex of meteorological fury. It does more damage to targets surrounded by empty space.

Converts a small portion of the brain matter of those around you into alcohol, attempting to confuse all intelligent creatures within view (although poison-resistant creatures may resist the effects). The caster will experience vertigo briefly if they successfully make contact with other minds. It is frequently used as an icebreaker at wizard parties.

Constructs a mobile and combat-capable alchemical manufactory. It uses the friction of melee combat to brew a variety of useful potions, venting clouds of their toxic byproducts at whatever it punches.
